messages:
Maria G: FYI — Acme reported their March invoices look wrong after our Stripe export. Line items seem to be shifted between invoice IDs.

Maria G: Small CSV slice from the export:
```
invoice_id,line_id,description,unit_price,quantity
inv_001,li_101,Hosted API - compute,1200,1
inv_002,li_101,Hosted API - compute,1200,1
inv_003,li_102,Dedicated Reserved - GPU,5000,2
```

Kevin L: Is that from the daily dump or the finalized monthly run?

Maria G: It's the monthly finalize (job: `billing.monthly.finalize`, run_id=20260331-03). Attached full export in the ticket.

Andrew S: Can you paste the exporter logs around creation time? Might be a retry/idempotency problem.

Maria G: Logs excerpt:
```
[03:12:45] billing_exporter: writing 1234 rows to stripe_export_20260331.csv
[03:12:46] stripe_client: created invoice inv_002
[03:12:46] billing_exporter: wrote line li_101 => inv_001
[03:12:46] billing_exporter: wrote line li_101 => inv_002
```

Julia P: :eyes: that looks like the exporter wrote the same line twice to two different invoices — maybe our cursor checkpointing happened mid-chunk.

Saad: Could be chunk flush order: we ack invoice create before flushing remaining rows in the in-memory buffer.

Andrew S: I'll check DB transaction boundaries and the exporter checkpoint code. Did you open a ticket?

Maria G: Yep, ticket TICK-4981 created (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TICK-4981). CC'ed finance and eng-runtime. Customer notified and we promised a follow-up in 2 hours.

Kevin L: Recommend pausing the monthly export for all workspaces while we triage. Need approval from finance ops lead.

Julia P: I approve pausing for 30 minutes while we investigate :thumbsup:

BillingBot: System: paused job `billing.monthly.finalize` for workspace `AcmeCorp` by Maria G at 2026-03-31T03:35:12Z

Andrew S: I'll own the investigation. Will update ticket and post root-cause findings. If bug, we'll roll fix and re-run export with safe dedupe.

Maria G: Thanks — I'll prepare a credit note template for any affected invoices and coordinate customer comms. Updating ticket now.
